text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Done and duuuuusteeeed!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Good work, everyone...! Wow, the storage 
room is completely spotless now.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fr fr! But like, wasn't it totally 
unhinged before we cleaned? It was 
literally rivaling the Heli-Tap room, 
majorly sketchy vibes!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I feel like you oughta 
clean your dorm room too... Well anyway, 
that's that settled!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
When sensei came rushing into the 
classroom looking super distressed, it 
really gave me a shock, though—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought it was 'Storage 
room's so cluttered there's an avalanche!' 
Honestly, I'm just glad it was something 
we could fix since we were hanging back by 
coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Having Miracle jump in halfway through 
helped out suuuuper big time too! Thanks a 
bunch~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that, though, since you were 
in the middle of solo training. You ended 
up staying with us right until the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. Getting to work alongside 
all my classmates was actually really fun.

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Everyone~! I am so, so sorry! Thanks for 
your hard work— Wait, wow, amazing?! It's 
completely spotless...!

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, thank you all so much! It's not much, 
but I bought some treats for you all—!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hoooo! Teach, thank yuuu★ Whoa, no way, 
cream puffs!!

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yup! One each for Shion-san, Palmer-san, 
and Helios-san... Wait, huh? Oh dear?

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san?! You were helping out too?! 
Oh no, I'm so sorry, umm—!!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, please don't worry about it. I 
just joined in on my own accord.

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Ehh, but...!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's completely fine, really. I 
don't eat much anyway, and I'm not hungry.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Please give the treats to everyone who was 
working hard from the very beginning.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, I'll be heading back to 
training.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah, Mira-P?! ...And she's gone.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow. How do I put it, yeah... 
Miracle-san always does stuff like that, 
doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah~... Ahaha, I totally get what you mean.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, your treat? In return for showing you 
my English notes? No, really... please 
don't worry about it at all.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Just getting to drink Hachimi together 
with you is more than enough for me. 
Thanks for inviting me, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No really, you don't need to thank me. As 
long as it helped you out, Shion, that's 
all that matters.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you ever need anything else, let me 
help. See you later, Shion.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Like... whenever someone's in trouble, she 
notices right away and comes over to 
help... She's so gentle, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. ...But once everyone's taken 
care of, she just casually slips away, 
y'know? Saying she doesn't need thanks or 
anything in return~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: She's such a sweet girl, but well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It makes you just a tiny bit worried, 
y'know? ...Just kidding, ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As sunset drew near. While many girls 
were already wrapping up and heading home, 
I spotted KS Miracle still running with 
single-minded devotion.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah... Phew.
choice_data_list: Call out to her out of concern

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Ah, were you talking to me?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine, really. Not tired at all. I'm 
just doing this because I want to.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry for making you worry about 
me.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm really okay. ...I truly am.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Pheeewww... Alright.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text: Not yet, I can keep going... HAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, KS Miracle vanished into the 
crimson glow of dusk.
